formula: net_liquidity = WALCL - WDTGAL - RRPONTSYD, in USD billions: WALCL and WDTGAL are USD millions divided by 1,000; RRPONTSYD is already USD billions
alignment: One point per WALCL Wednesday. WDTGAL must be reported for that same Wednesday. RRPONTSYD is taken from that Wednesday, or when that day is blank on or after 2013-09-23, from Tuesday only; before that date a blank Wednesday has no fallback. Each point names the RRP date used. Weeks without an aligned TGA or RRP value are skipped and counted, never filled with zero.

RRPONTSYD.alignment: the value for the WALCL Wednesday; when blank on or after 2013-09-23, Tuesday only; no fallback before that date. Reported per point as reverse_repo_observed_at; never a later day

method.tga_choice: The Treasury General Account term is WDTGAL (Wednesday level), not WTREGEN (week average), so all three terms describe the same Wednesday. WTREGEN is not a drop-in replacement: subtracting a week average from Wednesday-level total assets mixes two different measures. WTREGEN is served on its own by intel_fed_liquidity_series.

data_gaps: FRED's keyless CSV carries observation dates only: published_at is null, and units/frequency come from the server's series catalog, not the payload.
